title: High Five
summary: Given a list of student scores, calculate the top five average score for each student.
statement: Given a list of student scores, calculate the top five average score for each student. Return the results as an array of pairs sorted by student ID in ascending order.
constraints: Each student has at least five scores.
Return IDs increasing with the floor average of each student’s top five.
hints: Sort each student’s scores descending and select five.
Floor-divide their sum by five and emit IDs in sorted order.
Grouping isolates students and sorting identifies exactly their five greatest scores.
editorial: Grouping isolates students and sorting identifies exactly their five greatest scores.

tests.explanation: Student one averages 87 and student two 88 across their best five.
The sole top-five average is eighty.
